hero_lede: Medicine Anytime Anywhere. We're a European telemedicine platform connecting patients with locally-licensed doctors. No call centres, no waiting rooms, no surprise fees. You see who you're booking, what it costs, and when they're free.
p1_body: Every clinician on the platform is licensed in your country. No off-shore call centres, no rota of strangers. The doctor on the profile is the doctor on the call.
p2_body: Pick a date, pick a time, pay only after the call connects. No upfront forms, no insurance pre-auth, no 'we'll call you back within 5 business days'.
p3_body: Your data lives in EU data centres. We don't sell it, we don't profile you, we don't share it with insurers. The only people who see your records are the doctor on your call and you.
s1_title: Pick a country, then a service
s1_body: Click your flag. Browse general consultations, specialist consultations, or home tests. Prices and durations are listed up front.
s2_body: Every doctor's profile lists qualifications, languages, registration body. Pick a date from the rail, pick a time on that date.
s3_title: Pay only after the call connects
s3_body: Stripe processes the payment the moment the doctor joins the video call. If something goes wrong on our end, you don't pay.
s4_title: Get referrals, certificates, or test kits at home
s4_body: Where clinically appropriate, the doctor can issue referrals, certificates, or follow-up guidance. Notes are shared after the consultation according to the service and country workflow.
